1.text: Dore mukunzi wanjye we,Uri mwiza ni koko uri mwiza.Amaso yawe ameze nk'ay'inyana hagati y'imishunzi yawe,Umusatsi wawe umeze nk'umukumbi w'ihene,Ziryamye mu ibanga ry'umusozi w'i Galeyadi.

2.text: Amenyo yawe yera nk'umukumbi w'intama zakemuwe zivuye kuhagirwa,Zose zigenda zikurikirwa n'impanga zazo,Ntihagira n'imwe ipfusha.

3.text: Iminwa yawe imeze nk'ubudodo butukura,Kandi mu kanwa kawe ni heza.Mu misaya yawe hameze nk'igisate cy'ikomamanga,Hagati y'imishunzi yawe.

4.text: Ijosi ryawe rimeze nk'umunara wa Dawidi,Wubakiwe gushyingurwamo intwaro,Utendetsemo ingabo igihumbi,Ingabo zose z'intwari ze.

5.text: Amabere yawe ameze nk'inyagazi ebyiri,Impanga z'isirabo,Zirisha mu myangange.

6.text: Kugeza mu mafu ya nimunsi,Izuba rikendakenda,Ndajya ku musozi uriho ishangi,No ku gasozi kariho icyome.

7.text: Uri mwiza bihebuje mukunzi wanjye,Nta nenge ufite.

8.text: Ngwino tuvane i Lebanoni, mugeni wanjye,Tuvane i Lebanoni.Itegereze uri mu mpinga zo muri Amana,Uri mu mpinga z'i Seniri n'i Herumoni,Uri mu mavumo y'intare,Uri mu misozi ibamo ingwe.

9.text: Wansābye umutima,Mushiki wanjye, mugeni wanjye,Wanshabishije umutima n'ijisho ryawe,N'umukufi wo mu ijosi ryawe.

10.text: Urukundo rwawe ko ari rwiza,Mushiki wanjye, mugeni wanjye!Urukundo rwawe ko rundutira vino,Kandi impumuro y'amavuta yawe ikandutira imibavu y'ubwoko bwose.

11.text: Iminwa yawe mugeni wanjye, iratonyangaho ubuki,Umutsama n'amata biri munsi y'ururimi rwawe,Kandi impumuro y'imyambaro yawe,Ni nk'impumuro y'i Lebanoni.

12.text: Mushiki wanjye we, mugeni wanjye,Uri umurima uzitiwe,N'isōko yasibye,N'iriba ryashyizweho ikimenyetso gifatanye.

13.text: Ibishibutse byawe ni umurima w'imikomamanga,Weramo imbuto nziza,Koferi n'uduti twa narada,

14.text: Narada na Karukoma,Kāne na mudarasini n'uduti twose tw'icyome,Ishangi n'umusagavu n'imibavu yose iruta iyindi.

15.text: Uri iriba ryo hagati y'imirima,Uri isōko y'amazi abeshaho,N'imigezi itemba ituruka i Lebanoni. Umugeni:

16.text: Kanguka wa muyaga w'ikasikazi we,Nawe uw'ikusi ngwino,Huha hejuru y'umurima wanjye,Kugira ngo impumuro y'imibavu ihari ikwire hose.Reka umukunzi wanjye aze mu murima we,Arye amatunda ye meza. Umukwe:
